# GifSpark

> GifSpark turns any portrait into a shareable animated photo — a short looping video you can send anywhere. AI-powered, ready in seconds.

GifSpark is a web app that takes a single portrait photo and animates it with a short motion style (wave, smile, dance, and more). The result is delivered as MP4, animated WebP, or GIF.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Upload a portrait and generate an animated photo.
- [Trust & Safety](/legal): Consent, privacy, AI disclosure, and abuse reporting.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/auth): Account sign-in page.
